Before opening an issue, check whether the problem is already reported: the
search box at the top of the page filters by keyword.

Three templates, depending on what you need:

- **Bug** — something does not work. A document that reproduces it is needed:
  without one, in many cases there is only guessing.
- **Feature** — something is missing. Describe the problem, not the solution.
- **Question** — how to use it.

For a **security** defect do not use an issue: use the link below. Issues are
public and whoever reads one could use the defect before there is a fix.

The interface is in Italian, so quote menu entries exactly as they appear.
The manual is in [English](../../MANUAL.md) and [Italian](../../docs/it/MANUALE.md).

The program does not use the network. Replies come from its author, not from an
automated service.
